Upgrade to Main
  1. Saver fares cannot choose seats. Seats will be assigned at check-in.
  2. Passengers are allowed one carry-on and one personal item. Overhead bin space is on a first-come, first-served basis. Atmos™ Rewards passengers keep elite boarding status.
  3. Status members do not receive preferred seating benefits. Status members are eligible for same-day upgrade benefits with Saver fares 2 hours prior to departure. On all fares, including Saver, status members receive baggage allowances, check-in benefits, and priority boarding.
  4. Our 24-hour cancellation and same-day confirmed policies apply to all fares. When canceled, Saver fares are eligible for a credit of 50% of the ticket value when canceled at least 14 days prior to departure of the first flight on the ticket. Otherwise, Saver fares may not be changed or canceled.
  5. Saver fares traveling on or before July 31, 2026 earn at a rate of 30% of Main Cabin fares. Saver fares traveling on or after August 1, 2026 will no longer earn Atmos points.

 About contract fares
  • Contract fares are special, contract awarded fares, such as corporate discount fares and government fares.
  • Select this option to search for these special fares.
  • These fares are not combinable with Discount Codes.
 About credits, discounts, and companion fare codes

Discount codes are used to reduce the fare of applicable new ticket purchases and can be redeemed during their offer period at alaskaair.com, the Alaska Airlines mobile app and EasyBiz®. Discount codes cannot be redeemed after the offer period expires, and are forfeited if the ticket is changed or canceled.

Companion fare codes are unique discount codes that are issued annually to the following eligible cardholders. They cannot be transferred or redeemed by anyone other than the cardholder, and expire if not used within a year of issuance.

Flight Pass credits are unique discount codes that are issued on a monthly or bi-monthly basis depending on subscription plan enrollment. They cannot be transferred or redeemed by anyone other than the Flight Pass subscriber. Flight Pass credits expire if not used by the end of validity and are forfeited if the ticket is changed or canceled after validity.

Alaska Airlines Visa® Business card

Credit and gift certificates are NOT discount codes. Enter credit and gift certificate codes on the Payment page with their associated PIN.. See our credit certificates page for more info.

Where to find discount codes

Discount codes may be included in your Insider Newsletter, Mileage Plan correspondence, social media, e-mail, direct mail, special advertisements and marketing campaigns, or via promotional partners. Some discount codes, such as companion fare codes which are issued to eligible cardholders, are stored in your account profile

How to use discount codes

To redeem a discount code, type the code in the box marked 'Discount or companion fare code' where you select your travel cities and dates.

View terms and conditions
Discount code View terms
Using a discount code
  • To redeem a discount code, type the code in the box marked discount code on the same page you enter your travel cities and dates.
  • Discount codes can be stored in your My account profile to be accessed for later use.
General rules for discount codes
  • Only one discount code may be applied per reservation.
  • Discount codes may be used in conjunction with gift certificates or credit certificates, or Wallet funds.
  • Discount codes can only be redeemed for airfare purchases at alaskaair.com, the Alaska Airlines mobile app and EasyBiz for electronic tickets with a maximum of eight segments.
  • Discount codes cannot be applied to Mileage Plan award reservations.
  • Discount codes apply to original purchases only, and cannot be applied during ticket exchanges. If the ticket is canceled, the value of the discount is forfeited.
  • Discount codes can only be redeemed for flights operated by Alaska Air, Horizon Air, and/or Skywest as Alaska Airlines.
  • * Point-to-point fares are calculated for each flight's departure and arrival. Through fares are calculated from departure city to arrival city.

* Point-to-point fares are calculated for each flight's departure and arrival. Through fares are calculated from departure city to arrival city.
